_comment: LLM prompt text for the analysis app, externalized from prompts.py — same pattern as assistant/prompts.json. prompts.py fills in the {placeholder} slots via str.format(); keep names in sync on both sides.
response_schema_hint:
Respond with ONLY a JSON object matching this exact shape, no other text:
{
  "summary": "1-2 sentence overview of the applicant's results so far",
  "interview_patterns": ["short bullet describing something common among jobs that led to an interview or offer", "..."],
  "rejection_patterns": ["short bullet describing something common among jobs that were rejected or ghosted", "..."],
  "recommendations": ["short, actionable suggestion for what to do differently", "..."]
}
Do not invent numbers or percentages — only describe qualitative patterns (job titles, seniority, industry, location, employment type, notes) you actually see in the data below.
sample_size_note: Note: there are very few decided applications so far. Say so plainly in the summary and hedge the patterns instead of overclaiming confidence.
